hooks.command: jq -nc --arg t "$(date '+%A, %Y-%m-%d %I:%M %p %Z')" --arg iso "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg short "$(date '+%I:%M %p %Z')" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:("Now-Aware: current local time is " + $t + " (UTC " + $iso + "). Use this for any time-of-day language (morning/afternoon/evening/tonight/tomorrow). Never guess time from prior context — it goes stale. If the user references a relative time, anchor it to this timestamp.\n\nMessage stamping: BEGIN every response with the marker `[" + $short + "]` on its own first line so the user can see when each message landed. If you stall or a long task crashes, the last visible message will still show its timestamp.")}}'
